events.info: One legendary voice. Two extraordinary milestones. One unforgettable night. Join us for an evening celebrating the incomparable Dorothy Moore as she commemorates her 80th birthday and the 50th anniversary of her timeless hit, "Misty Blue." For more than five decades, Dorothy Moore has captivated audiences around the world with one of the most recognizable voices in soul, rhythm & blues, and gospel. This special Diamond & Gold Concert honors an extraordinary career filled with classic songs, unforgettable performances, and enduring musical excellence. Opening the evening is M'Eubie (Michael Eubanks), an electrifying saxophonist whose dynamic stage presence and high-energy performance will set the tone for an unforgettable night of music and celebration. Whether you arrive in your favorite jeans, business attire, or your finest diamonds and gold, gather your family and friends for an evening of timeless music, cherished memories, and a celebration worthy of a true legend.
